basic_info.description: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, Cow Hollow, 1601  Lombard Street offers a unique investment opportunity with an exceptional location  and expansive living space. Built in 1925, the property retains traditional architectural charm while being ideally  situated to take full advantage of the vibrant energy of Chestnut Street and Union  Streettwo of the city's most lively and well-known corridors.  Just steps from the property, Chestnut Street and Union Street offers a range of  shopping, dining, and leisure options.  1601 Lombard Street is a 13-unit corner property consisting of one studio and 11 one-  bedroom units and 10 parking spaces with an adjacent retail space. The building is  separately metered for gas and electric. Electric heating provides reliable comfort  throughout the year, making the space functional for both residents and potential  renters. 1601 Lombard Street is an attractive prospect for investors. Its prime location near  both Chestnut Street and Union Street, combined with the spacious layout and modern  amenities, make it an ideal candidate for multi-family livng or as a rental property.  This is a rare opportunity to own a substantial property in one of San Francisco's most  dynamic and sought-after neighborhoods.
